description: This file defines the SyntheticsClient class for interacting with the AWS Synthetics service, including method signatures for various service actions and their async counterparts.

classes.name: SyntheticsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Synthetics service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: associateResource
methods.description: Associates a resource with the Synthetics service.

methods.name: createCanary
methods.description: Creates a new canary in the Synthetics service.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group within the Synthetics service.

methods.name: deleteCanary
methods.description: Deletes a canary from the Synthetics service.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a group within the Synthetics service.

methods.name: describeCanaries
methods.description: Retrieves details about existing canaries.

methods.name: describeCanariesLastRun
methods.description: Gets the last run details for canaries.

methods.name: describeRuntimeVersions
methods.description: Lists the runtime versions available.

methods.name: disassociateResource
methods.description: Removes association of a resource from the Synthetics service.

methods.name: getCanary
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific canary.

methods.name: getCanaryRuns
methods.description: Lists the recent runs of a canary.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific group.

methods.name: listAssociatedGroups
methods.description: Lists groups associated with resources.

methods.name: listGroupResources
methods.description: Lists resources within a group.

methods.name: listGroups
methods.description: Lists all groups.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags assigned to a resource.

methods.name: startCanary
methods.description: Starts a canary.

methods.name: stopCanary
methods.description: Stops a running canary.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCanary
methods.description: Updates an existing canary.
